# LeonardoMD 0.1.353 Beta
Markdown tables now accept an optional preceding comment to control column widths:
```markdown <!-- leonardo:table widths="10ch 15ch auto" --> ```
Long headers wrap within their selected columns, while `auto` uses the remaining space. Narrow windows scroll horizontally inside the table. Ordinary tables preserve whole words. Invalid directives and code examples are ignored safely. This beta is for Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later.
Changes: [PR #131](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/131).

# LeonardoMD 0.1.349
This stable release enables future beta subscriptions.
- Open Preferences → Updates to choose Stable or Beta. Stable is the default; opting into Beta includes both stable and experimental releases. - Use Check for updates now or enable periodic automatic checks in Preferences. You decide when to install. - Active or deferred update decisions protect the channel selection and survive restart. - Returning from Beta to Stable waits for a newer stable build; the app never downgrades.
This arm64 distribution requires macOS 14 or later. It preserves the existing stable signing trust root and user data. Old beta packages with a different update signing key must install a current signed/notarized package manually.
Promoted from validated beta 0.1.348 with unchanged application and dependency sources, using a higher ledger-materialized build. Publication and hosted update evidence: https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/15#issuecomment-6124736089
